scope: Independent review of 16 round-three additions, supplementing the prior 169-record raw-source audit. No shared place data changed by this audit.
method: Reparsed cached original OSM XML and fresh bounded OSM source extracts independently from generated audit geometry.
Matched exact nodes, checked polygon containment with ray casting, and independently recomputed translated-coordinate shoelace centroids.
Verified official CPD HTML geolocation metadata for both habitat-reference exceptions; checked special names/ensemble anchors against primary CPD pages and OSM relation membership.
Compared integrated coordinates, mapped all pins into the existing 5200 × 6900 canvas, and checked nearest neighbors against all 185 integrated discoveries.

officialGeolocationEvidence.retrieval: Read directly from public CPD HTML during this audit; response body was not stored.

records.name: Grant Park Fountain Figures
records.coordinateMethod: area-weighted centroid, checked inside the mapped feature; point marks Fisher Boy in the northern pair, not the center of all four fountains
records.notes: The selected exact Fisher Boy footprint represents an ensemble of four fountains. CPD confirms Fisher Boy and Crane Girl north of Buckingham, Turtle Boy and Dove Girl south; the published practical text explicitly identifies this northern-pair anchor.

limitations: Community-mapped coordinates and polygon containment are not survey-grade guarantees or an on-site visit.
Raw source parsing verifies geographic identity/geometry; it does not independently certify every historical fact, photo subject, closure, or public access detail.
Both habitat pins are official representative reference points, not precise trail entrances; their broader OSM polygons are supporting context.
Most source XML was cached earlier; fresh exact node and bounded extracts were supplied by the inventory audit. Source versions and timestamps are retained.
